description: On desktop, the app's own page may hold a workspace's engine lock through the engine_lock_* commands: the one engine a workspace may have open, in the same file and format as the CLI's (crates/run-lock). The shell keeps the lock for the window, so a page reload takes it back. The page names a workspace the person opened, never a path. It is local only, so the Studio the computer serves gets no lock.
